---
title: "Q1 Differential expression"
format: html
---

*Which genes are differentially expressed between patients with complete response and patients with progressive disease following anti-PD-L1 treatment?*

- Prepare and explore the gene-expression data, including appropriate filtering and normalization.

- Perform differential expression analysis between responders/non-responder using DESeq2, and identify significantly differentially expressed genes

- Visualize the results using e.g. volcano plots and heatmaps of selected genes.

- Investigate the biological functions of differentially expressed genes and discuss their potential relevance to immunotherapy response.

- Discuss the limitations of the analysis, including potential confounding factors and why differential expression does not necessarily imply a causal role in treatment response.

## Data and libraries

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
IMVigor <- readRDS("data/IMvigor210_plain.rds")

# Load packages silently

library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)


clinical <- IMVigor$clinical
counts <- IMVigor$counts
tpm <- IMVigor$tpm

```

```{r}
colnames(clinical)
dim(clinical)

dim(counts)
dim(tpm)

```


## Filtering and normalization

```{r}
# Check if row names is the same as both pat_id and sample_id

if (!all(rownames(clinical) == clinical$pat_id)) {stop("Row names of clinical data do not match pat_id")
}

if (!all(rownames(clinical) == clinical$sample_id)) {stop("Row names of clinical data do not match pat_id")
}

clinical_filtered <- clinical |> 
  filter(sample_id == pat_id) |> 
  select(pat_id, BOR, TMB)

dim(clinical_filtered)

```


```{r}
# Filter sample_ids from counts and tpm which are not present in clinical and reverse

counts_filtered <- as.data.frame(counts) |> 
  select(clinical_filtered$pat_id)

tpm_filtered <- as.data.frame(tpm) |> 
  select(clinical_filtered$pat_id)

dim(counts_filtered)
dim(tpm_filtered)

```
```{r}
# Check for missing values in counts
sum(is.na(counts_filtered))

```

```{r}
table(clinical_filtered$BOR)

# As DESEQ expects 0's and 1's the BOR column is mutated

clinical_filtered$BOR <- ifelse(clinical_filtered$BOR == "R", 1, 0)

table(clinical_filtered$BOR)

clinical_filtered$BOR <- as.factor(clinical_filtered$BOR)

counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_filtered)

all(colnames(counts_matrix) == rownames(clinical_filtered))

```
## Differential expression analysis

```{r}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_matrix,
                              colData = clinical_filtered,
                              design = ~ BOR)

dim(dds)
```
```{r}
# Remove genes with very low counts, to reduce the number of tests and improve power

dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]


dim(dds)

# This removed roughly 8000 genes
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
res <- results(dds, alpha = 0.05)

summary(res)
```


## Visualizations
```{r}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) |> 
  filter(!is.na(padj)) |> 
  rownames_to_column("gene") |> 
  mutate(significant = padj < 0.05) |>
  arrange(padj) 

```


```{r}
# Volcano plot

volcano_plot <- res_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano plot of differential expression",
       x = "Log2 fold change",
       y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

volcano_plot


```
